x, y, n = map(float, input().split())
n = int(n)
target = x / y
closest = 0
numerator = 0
denominator = 1

import math

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    floor_value = int(math.floor(target * i))
    ceil_value = int(math.ceil(target * i))
    if abs(target - floor_value / i) + 1e-15 < abs(target - closest):
        numerator = floor_value
        denominator = i
        closest = floor_value / i
    if abs(target - ceil_value / i) + 1e-15 < abs(target - closest):
        numerator = ceil_value
        denominator = i
        closest = ceil_value / i

gcd_val = math.gcd(numerator, denominator)
print(f"{numerator // gcd_val}/{denominator // gcd_val}")
